minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved all four hearing items, continued one septic NOI to March 15, and planned April Earth Day events.
minutes.summary: The Commission held a remote meeting with a bare quorum. It heard two requests for determination of applicability (48 Oak Ridge, 1083 Northfield Road), an amended order of conditions (Northfield Road driveway), a notice of intent for a septic system at Horizon Island Road (continued), and an RDA for PJ Keating's detention basin. It also extended and amended an order of conditions at 1325 Mass Ave, and discussed Earth Day plans, encroachments, the Hollis Road work and the Howard Street driveway.

budget_items.what_was_said: The planning board again granted the Commission free GIS hours at the regional planning commission, so the amount in the purchase order likely won't be spent.
The invoice can be paid without a vote but needs a purchase order, which the Commission then voted to approve.
DPW obtained four quotes and may pay from its own budget in June; the Commission agreed to wait rather than pay from its funds, noting it already spent on an engineered plan.
Shirts and awards were deferred to next year because of limited time to arrange design and funding.
Only one firm estimate exists; the member wants two more before proceeding.

decisions.decision: Applicant for 105 Horizon Island Road to return with a plan showing existing trees and proposed removals and replacements, plus the walls within the 50-foot zone.
By consensus, the Commission authorised advertising a joint Earth Day effort with Parks and Recreation through April, with a dedicated Gmail account.
Consensus to wait until June for DPW to fund the Howard Street driveway rather than use Commission funds.
Two members to self-organize with the volunteer leader on a spring bird study at the field, expected late April or May.

what_happened.line: The Commission approved a two-year extension and red-line changes to the order of conditions at 1325 Mass Ave, by roll call.
It issued negative determinations on three requests for determination of applicability: 48 Oak Ridge, 1083 Northfield Road, and PJ Keating's detention basin.
It approved an amended order of conditions relocating a shared driveway at 759 and 763 Northfield Road.
It continued the septic notice of intent at 105 Horizon Island Road to March 15 and asked the applicant for a plan of existing trees, removals and walls.
By consensus it will advertise a joint Earth Day effort with Parks and Recreation through April, and will wait until June for DPW to fund the Howard Street driveway.

why_it_matters: These are routine permit decisions on wetlands and buffer-zone work, and they set what neighbors can build near protected land, such as the Horizon Island Road septic and tree plan still pending.
The Howard Street driveway is being left for DPW to pay in June rather than from Commission funds, which shifts that cost toward the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: March 15 continued hearing on the Horizon Island Road septic notice of intent.
DPW funding decision for the Howard Street driveway work, expected in June.
